title.en: The cell cycle and its phases

heading.en: From one cell to a whole body

hook.en: You began life as one cell, the zygote. Today you have trillions. Each of them came from a cell that grew, copied its DNA and divided in an orderly cycle.
hook.kn: ನೀವು ಒಂದೇ ಜೀವಕೋಶವಾದ ಯುಗ್ಮಜದಿಂದ ಆರಂಭವಾದಿರಿ. ಇಂದು ನಿಮ್ಮಲ್ಲಿ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಕೋಟಿ ಜೀವಕೋಶಗಳಿವೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದೂ ಬೆಳೆದು, DNA ನಕಲು ಮಾಡಿ, ಕ್ರಮಬದ್ಧ ಚಕ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಜನೆಯಾದ ಜೀವಕೋಶದಿಂದ ಬಂದಿದೆ.

objectives.en: Define the cell cycle and give its duration in human cells and yeast.
Describe G1, S and G2 of interphase.

narration.en: You began life as one cell, the zygote. Today you have trillions. Each of them came from a cell that grew, copied its DNA and divided in an orderly cycle.
narration.kn: ನೀವು ಒಂದೇ ಜೀವಕೋಶವಾದ ಯುಗ್ಮಜದಿಂದ ಆರಂಭವಾದಿರಿ. ಇಂದು ನಿಮ್ಮಲ್ಲಿ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಕೋಟಿ ಜೀವಕೋಶಗಳಿವೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದೂ ಬೆಳೆದು, DNA ನಕಲು ಮಾಡಿ, ಕ್ರಮಬದ್ಧ ಚಕ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಜನೆಯಾದ ಜೀವಕೋಶದಿಂದ ಬಂದಿದೆ.

body.en: The cell cycle is the sequence of events by which a cell duplicates its genome, synthesises other constituents and divides into two daughter cells. A typical human cell in culture divides about once every 24 hours; yeast takes only about 90 minutes. The cycle has two basic phases: interphase, the phase between two successive M phases, which lasts more than 95% of the cycle, and the M phase (mitosis), which lasts only about an hour in human cells. The M phase starts with karyokinesis (division of the nucleus) and usually ends with cytokinesis (division of the cytoplasm).

points.en: Interphase is not a resting phase: the cell prepares for division.

narration.en: Let us draw the cell cycle as a clock and track the DNA content round it.

say.en: The cell cycle is a circle: interphase, made of G1, S and G2, followed by the short M phase.
In a human cell in culture the whole cycle takes about 24 hours, and M phase only about one hour. Over 95 per cent is interphase.
DNA is copied in S phase, so the content goes from 2C to 4C, but the number of chromosomes does not change.
Some cells leave G1 and stop dividing. This quiescent stage is called G0: the cells stay alive and active.

caption.en: A human cell in culture divides about once in 24 hours. Interphase (G1, S, G2) takes more than 95% of the time; mitosis lasts about an hour. DNA doubles from 2C to 4C during S phase and halves again when the cell divides. A cell can leave G1 to rest in G0.
caption.kn: ಮಾನವ ಕೋಶ ಸುಮಾರು 24 ಗಂಟೆಗೊಮ್ಮೆ ವಿಭಜಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಂತರಾವಸ್ಥೆ (G1, S, G2) 95% ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಮಯ; ಸಮವಿಭಜನೆ ಸುಮಾರು ಒಂದು ಗಂಟೆ. S ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ DNA 2C ಯಿಂದ 4C ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೋಶ G1 ನಿಂದ G0 ಗೆ ಹೋಗಬಹುದು.

body.en: In G1 the cell is metabolically active and grows continuously but does not replicate its DNA. In the S (synthesis) phase DNA replicates: if the initial amount is 2C, it becomes 4C, but the chromosome number does not change (2n stays 2n). In animal cells the centriole also duplicates in the cytoplasm during S. In G2 proteins are made for mitosis while growth continues. Some cells in adult animals, such as heart cells, do not appear to divide, and many others divide only occasionally to replace lost cells. Cells that do not divide further exit G1 into an inactive stage called the quiescent stage (G0); they remain metabolically active but do not proliferate unless called on.

points.en: S phase: DNA 2C → 4C; chromosome number unchanged.
G0: metabolically active but not dividing.
In plants, both mitotic and meiotic divisions can occur in haploid and diploid cells.

narration.kn: G1 ನಲ್ಲಿ ಜೀವಕೋಶ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, S ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ DNA 2C ಯಿಂದ 4C ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ ಆದರೆ ವರ್ಣತಂತುಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. G2 ನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಜನೆಗೆ ಪ್ರೋಟೀನ್ ತಯಾರಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿಭಜನೆಯಾಗದ ಜೀವಕೋಶಗಳು G0 ಹಂತಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ.

caption.en: During the S phase the DNA double helix unzips and each strand is copied, so the DNA content doubles from 2C to 4C.
caption.kn: S ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ DNA ದ್ವಿಕುಂಡಲಿ ಬಿಚ್ಚಿಕೊಂಡು ಪ್ರತಿ ಎಳೆ ನಕಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ DNA ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 2C ಯಿಂದ 4C ಗೆ ದ್ವಿಗುಣವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
